originalRunner.behavior: Imports through the real MiniApps UI, creates a fresh instance, places and configures an actual medium WidgetKit widget, terminates the host, taps Fail refresh, verifies fresh correlated fallback, waits for the authored retry boundary, then taps the cached Recover control.

requiredEnvironment.SPLIT_EVIDENCE: A fresh absolute evidence root owned by the original Mac controller; the runner creates paired-product with exist_ok=False.

originalRunner.runtimeSelection: Use the actual owned installed runtime through the original PAIRED_SIM_RUNTIME option. The last independently observed runtime was com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimRuntime.iOS-27-2; admission remains with the Mac owner.

observationBoundary: Current installed app, data container, configured AppGroup, canonical enabled catalog, installed generation, fresh instance, exact fixture source, eight published families, program and cached render are verified read-only.

The observer starts only its own read-only Simulator system log stream. The native fallback event must bind exact identity, generation, family, program, failed state revision, retained render, actual PID and installed WidgetKit process path.

The failed state must commit one fresh action nonce while the previously verified cache remains unchanged. Recovery requires the actual second UI callback, second nonce, count 2, fail false, retryAfter 0 and a new render after recovery was armed.
A passive render after the authored 90-second retry boundary cannot qualify recovery.
Immediately before terminal output, actual MCM roots, configuration, app Info digest and installed extension path/configuration are resolved again and must match the admitted identity.
Only the original XCTest runner observation response and external evidence are written; no production catalog, grants, commands, queues, snapshots or native receipts are seeded.
preserved: All fourteen existing system-surface UI test methods and their helper behavior remain; one additive method is selected only by the new scope.
The original paired 54 selectors, other existing scopes and original verify_selected_tests.py verifier remain.
The existing fourteen observer unit methods remain, with six additional pure negative controls. Unit fixture records are not Simulator evidence.
This four-file acceptance-only patch does not change the native product, runtime producer, package source, dependency pins, frozen ScriptWidget or ScriptUI engines.
pilotLimits: The Swift UI additions have not yet compiled or executed in Xcode.
Actual gallery/medium-family/configuration locators and NDJSON record field provenance must be confirmed by the genuine Mac pilot.

This one systemMedium Simulator case does not close the other seven Widget families, portrait/tint modes, network or corrupt-package failures, ActivityKit regions, physical-device acceptance or the complete Asana matrix.
reviewHistory: Independent reviewer identified a final container-readback gap and missing strict catalog generation type; both were corrected before final review and the final portable receipt.

sourceClosure.boundary: This compares exact changed-path membership against the retained actual 392-input producer manifest. It does not claim the older runtime artifact qualifies the newer native diagnostic; the Mac owner owns that fresh qualification.
